closedBlockers.resolution: The packaged offline ynx-wallet-product-session-state-migrate CLI requires exact old state, previous registry and current registry file SHA-256 values; reads safe owned files with O_NOFOLLOW; accepts only the canonical 6cf envelope; writes one new private 0600 output without overwrite.

The Product Session host now serves exact GET-only health, ready and version responses on both standalone root paths and aggregate /v2/product-sessions/* paths. Wrong method or body/proof headers fail closed without state mutation.

Version evidence exposes registryFileSha256 for raw file bytes and registryStateBindingSha256 for canonical parsed registry state binding; registrySha256 remains the parsed binding compatibility field.

The explicit migration accepts only schemaVersion,snapshot,snapshotDigest canonical 6cf state, verifies snapshotDigest and the entire source file SHA-256, then emits the registry-bound schemaVersion,registrySha256,snapshot,snapshotSha256 envelope.

Runtime path binding accepts the current YNX_WALLET_PRODUCT_SESSION_V2_* names or the deployed YNX_PRODUCT_SESSION_GATEWAY_* names; if both are present they must resolve to the same exact absolute paths or startup fails closed.

deploymentBoundary.nextAction: Integration must review this exact source candidate and issue a fresh bounded single-use lease before any SSH or deployment action.
